title: Goodman the athlete; roommates in the Pollack band
summary: Goodman was a good hand-ball player and golfer; they roomed with Harry Goodman and Gil Rodin in the Pollack band.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: I'd asked you to comment upon him and ...
Glen Miller as you know, people that you knew.

I think Benny Goodman was a very good hand ball player. He was a good athlete. He could beat all of us. Benny Goodman was a good athlete. And we played a little golf together. I was fairly good at golf.
This is still in your teens?

Oh yes. Oh yes. I used to play a lot of golf. I loved the game. I stopped football quick when I got a broken rib, that was enough. So, Benny Goodman was a great, great guy. We were pals and you know when I went with Ben Pollack band then we played at the Black Hawk in Chicago and then we went to New York. Why we roomed together, Harry Goodman, Gil Rodin, Benny Goodman and myself. And we cooked for ourselves and everything else.
